scenario_description:
Objective: Add a brief neighborhood-radio dedication to a confirmed butter-tea listening visit without changing the gathering itself.
Emerging Need: A broadcast extra appears before any listening table is definite; later messages, calendar details, and setup spending make it plausible and specific.
Decision Context: A private note supplies the respectful wording boundary and language choice that the public announcements do not contain.
Consequence: Using the short submission window can make the visit warmer and more culturally attentive; missing it leaves the tea unchanged.

parameter.subject: Thursday tea-hour dedication slots
parameter.body: For the Aug. 6 neighborhood cooking-hour broadcast, we have two no-cost dedication readings after the diaspora tea segment. Send a 20-word dedication and preferred language by Wednesday, Aug. 5 at 3:00 p.m. Dedications are only for confirmed listening tables; household or group addressees are fine, and no calls or recordings are involved.

parameter.content: Kunsang-la may stop by if we end up pouring butter tea this week, but her granddaughter has not set the ride yet. I should know tomorrow morning.

parameter.title: Thursday butter-tea listening visit
parameter.description: Small apartment tea during the community radio cooking hour; radio on low if reception works. Kunsang Dolma and Appa expected, with Nima handling the ride.

parameter.reference: butter tea leaves and tsampa biscuits

parameter.subject: Dedication board still open until 3 p.m.
parameter.body: Today’s board still has one Thursday tea-hour dedication slot. Reply to this announcement before 3:00 p.m. with the dedication line, language preference, and whether the addressee should be a name or a household/table phrase. The studio prints the rundown after the cutoff.

parameter.subject: Thursday tea-hour dedication board closed
parameter.body: The Aug. 6 tea-hour dedication board closed at 3:00 p.m., and the studio rundown has been printed. We cannot add more dedication lines for tomorrow’s cooking-hour broadcast.
